0.heading: Overview
refs: Acts 20:1 , Paul goes to Macedonia, and thence to Troas
Acts 20:7 , He celebrates the Lord's supper, and preaches
Acts 20:9 , Eutychus having fallen down dead is raised to life
Acts 20:17 , and at Miletum he calls the elders together, tells them what shall befall to himself
Acts 20:28 . commits God's flock to them
Acts 20:29 . warns them of false teachers
Acts 20:36 . prays with them, and departs.
